---
name: Feature proposal
about: Agree on a contributor-visible problem, scope and success criteria
---

<!-- Proposals are public. Do not include private repository contents, local paths,
logs/diagnostic DBs, credentials, account configuration or private product identifiers.
No Auto-K account or private graph access is required. Maintainers approve scope. -->

## Problem and affected users

What cannot users accomplish today? Use a concrete, non-sensitive example.

## Proposed behavior and scope

Describe the smallest change that solves the problem, including what is out of scope. This is a source developer preview; do not assume certified native installers or release support.

## Alternatives

Describe existing workarounds or other approaches and their trade-offs.

## Observable success criteria

How would a contributor and maintainer know the agreed behavior works? Include relevant platforms and browser/native boundaries, without requiring private planning artifacts.

## Dependencies and assets

Does this require new/updated dependencies, fonts, icons or bundled assets? Identify upstream provenance and known license/attribution requirements; do not assume all assets share a package's license. See CONTRIBUTING.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and PRs.
- [ ] The proposal contains no secrets, private data, raw local paths or diagnostic/log dumps.
- [ ] I understand this is a proposal, not scope approval, and will seek maintainer agreement before substantial implementation.
